title: Flexible dynamic modularity may be a necessary condition and a proxy for integration

statements.text: If consciousness involves the flexible formation of large integrative modules that can only form in networks with balanced integration and differentiation, valid proxies of integrated information should correlate with dynamic modularity, and modularity measures may give tractable estimates of integrated information.

sources.quote: if consciousness involves the flexible establishment of large-scale integrative modules (or “workspaces”), and if such complexes can only form for networks capable of establishing patterns of effective connectivity with balanced integration/differentiation
